text:
mira: Heads up — planning to onboard falcon-lite-8b-v2 to the model-catalog and push to staging today. Target deploy window 2025-11-10 15:00 PT. Need staging deploy owner + smoke test ✅

ben: I can own the staging deploy. I'll start at 14:45 PT to warm up infra. Will run smoke suite + latency check.

alex: Thanks — quick q: are we using the 4-bit quant config from the PR? How's KV cache expected to behave for chat workloads?

mira: Yes — using q4_k_m profile from model-profiles. KV cache unchanged. See PR: https://git.redwood/model-catalog/pull/492

sara: If we need rollback, plan is to pin to previous model sha and set fallback-policy=immediate. Runbook: /docs/runbooks/model-rollback.md

tom: Quick reminder: update manifest fields (tags, min_sequence, default_routing). Also add healthcheck endpoint: /_hc/model/falcon-lite-8b-v2

ben: Smoke test I'll run (curl example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"falcon-lite-8b-v2","input":"Hello"}'
```
I'll check latency < 120ms p50 and no memory OOM.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled by ben at 2025-11-10T14:45:00Z — job id 983412

mira: Assigning tasks — ben (staging deploy + smoke), alex (review quant config + perf), tom (manifest + healthcheck), sara (runbook + rollback signoff). Ping here when done.

ben: Got it, will post smoke results and raw logs here. ETA 15:05 PT.

alex: I'll review PR now, expect comments in 30m.

sara: I'll be on standby for rollback signoff 15:00–16:00 PT.

mira: If all green, plan is to pin to catalog v2.4.0 and schedule prod roll at next weekly window. No hot prod push today unless critical.

ben: smoke done — small spike at 95th to 380ms on long-context test, but p50 85ms. No errors. Posting status: "OK".

alex: LGTM on quant config after minor comment (batch size default -> 8).

mira: Thanks all — moving to close. If anyone sees a regression reply here so we can delay the pin.

ben: ack :thumbsup:
